overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBOOST AMD ETF (AMYY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed seeking current income and the daily 2x leverage of the price performance of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) AMYY was launched on Sep 16, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
